title: Crispy Salmon Katsu Roll
description: Panko-crusted cooked salmon with cucumber and Japanese mayonnaise.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

ingredients.name: Neutral cooking oil
ingredients.note: For shallow-frying; not all oil is absorbed

steps: Cut salmon into long thick strips and pat dry. Coat each in beaten egg and press on panko until evenly covered.
Heat cooking oil in a shallow pan and fry the strips, turning until evenly golden and cooked through. Drain thoroughly on a rack; do not seal steaming-hot fish inside nori.
Spread seasoned rice over a nori sheet. Lay crispy salmon alongside cucumber and a restrained line of Kewpie; roll tightly.
Cut into eight pieces and serve promptly while the coating is still crunchy.
notes: A little mayonnaise is sufficient; too much softens the panko.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
Salmon is fully cooked, including the very thin seared-slice variations; for thicker pieces, 63°C at the center is a conservative target.
